title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四 少帝
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四 少帝 Volume 4 Annals 4: Emperor Shao

sentences.zh: 永初三年五月癸亥，武帝崩，是日，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the fifth month of the third year of Yongchu, Emperor Wu died; on that same day the crown prince assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the fifth month of the third year of Yongchu, Emperor Wu died; that same day the crown prince ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 尊皇太后曰太皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was elevated to grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，以尚書僕射傅亮為中書監，司空徐羨之、領軍將軍謝晦及亮輔政。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the sixth month, Fu Liang, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, the General Who Leads the Army Xie Hui, and Liang were appointed to assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the sixth month, Fu Liang, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, the General Who Leads the Army Xie Hui, and Liang were made regents.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太尉長沙王道憐薨。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, the Grand Commandant, the Prince of Changsha, Dao Lian, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the Grand Commandant, Prince of Changsha Dao Lian, died.

sentences.zh: 秋九月丁未，有司奏武皇帝配南郊，武敬皇后配北郊。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the dingwei day of the ninth month, the relevant offices memorialized that Emperor Wu should be paired at the southern suburb altar and Empress Wu Jing at the northern suburb altar.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the dingwei day of the ninth month, the relevant offices submitted that Emperor Wu should receive joint sacrifice at the southern suburban altar and Empress Wu Jing at the northern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，有星孛于營室。

translations.literal: In winter, on the wuwu day of the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the Encampment mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the wuwu day of the eleventh month, a broom star appeared in the Encampment lodge.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，魏軍克滑臺。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, the Wei army captured Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, the Wei army took Huatai.

sentences.zh: 明年春正月己亥朔，大赦，改元為景平元年。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the first month of spring of the following year, the day jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingping, year one.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring of the following year, on the day jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingping, year one.

sentences.zh: 文武進位二等。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, sacrifice was offered at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the southern suburban sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: [3]虜將達奚卬破金墉，進圍虎牢。

translations.literal: [3] The barbarian general Daxi Ang captured Jinyong and advanced to besiege Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: [3] The enemy general Daxi Ang took Jinyong and pressed on to besiege Hulao.

sentences.zh: [4]毛德祖擊虜敗之，虜退而復合。

translations.literal: [4] Mao Dezu struck the barbarians and defeated them; the barbarians withdrew and then regrouped.
translations.idiomatic: [4] Mao Dezu attacked the enemy and routed them; the enemy withdrew and then rallied again.

sentences.zh: 拓跋木末又遣安平公涉歸寇青州。

translations.literal: Tuoba Mumo again sent the Prince of Anping, Shegui, to raid Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Mumo again sent the Prince of Anping, Shegui, to invade Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: [5]癸卯，河南郡失守。

translations.literal: [5] On the guimao day, Henan Commandery was lost.
translations.idiomatic: [5] On the guimao day, Henan Commandery fell.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，有星孛于東壁。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, a comet appeared in the Eastern Wall mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, a broom star appeared in the Eastern Wall lodge.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the second month, the grand empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the second month, the grand empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 沮渠蒙遜、吐谷渾阿犲並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Juqu Mengxun and Tuguhun A'ai both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mengxun and Tuguhun A'ai both sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，[6]爵蒙遜為驃騎大將軍，[7]封河西王。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, [6] Mengxun was ennobled as General of Agile Cavalry, [7] and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, [6] Mengxun was created General of Agile Cavalry [7] and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 以阿犲為安西將軍、沙州刺史，封澆河公。

translations.literal: A'ai was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Shazhou, and enfeoffed as Duke of Jiaohe.
translations.idiomatic: A'ai was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Shazhou, and created Duke of Jiaohe.

sentences.zh: 辛未，富陽人孫法光反，[8]寇山陰，會稽太守褚淡之遣山陰令陸劭討敗之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Sun Faguang of Fuyang rebelled, [8] raided Shanyin, and the Governor of Kuaiji Chu Danzhi sent the Magistrate of Shanyin Lu Shao to attack and defeat him.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Sun Faguang of Fuyang rose in revolt, [8] raided Shanyin, and the Governor of Kuaiji Chu Danzhi sent the Magistrate of Shanyin Lu Shao to defeat him.

translations.literal: [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，孝懿皇后祔葬于興寧陵。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the third month, Empress Xiaoyi was enshrined and buried at Xingning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the third month, Empress Xiaoyi was enshrined and buried at Xingning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 是月，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That month, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，豫州刺史劉粹遣軍襲許昌，殺虜潁川太守庾龍。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Liu Cui, Inspector of Yuzhou, sent troops to raid Xuchang and killed the barbarian Administrator of Yingchuan, Yu Long.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Liu Cui, Inspector of Yuzhou, sent troops to raid Xuchang and killed the enemy Administrator of Yingchuan, Yu Long.

sentences.zh: [10]乙丑，虜騎寇高平。

translations.literal: [10] On the yichou day, barbarian horsemen raided Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: [10] On the yichou day, enemy horsemen raided Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 初虜自河北之敗，請修和親；

translations.literal: Earlier, after their defeat north of the Yellow River, the barbarians had requested a marriage alliance;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after their defeat north of the Yellow River, the enemy had sought a marriage alliance;

sentences.zh: 及聞高祖崩，因復侵擾，河、洛之地騷然矣。

translations.literal: when they heard that Emperor Gaozu had died, they again launched raids, and the lands along the Yellow and Luo rivers were thrown into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: when they learned that Emperor Gaozu had died, they resumed their incursions, and the Yellow and Luo region was thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，檀道濟北征，次臨朐，焚虜攻具。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, halted at Linqu, and burned the barbarians' siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, halted at Linqu, and burned the enemy siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 乙未，魏軍克虎牢，執司州刺史毛德祖以歸。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the Wei army captured Hulao and took the Inspector of Sizhou, Mao Dezu, back with them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the Wei army took Hulao and carried off the Inspector of Sizhou, Mao Dezu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，尊所生張夫人為皇太后。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the guiyou day of the seventh month, the birth mother, Lady Zhang, was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the guiyou day of the seventh month, his birth mother, Lady Zhang, was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以旱，詔赦五歲刑以下罪人。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, because of drought, an edict pardoned offenders sentenced to five years or less.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, because of drought, an edict pardoned offenders sentenced to five years or less.

translations.literal: [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，有星孛于氐，指尾，貫攝提，向大角，仲月在危，季月掃天倉而後滅。

translations.literal: In winter, on the jiwei day of the tenth month, a comet appeared in the Root mansion, pointing toward the Tail, piercing Sheti, and heading toward the Great Horn; in the middle month it was in Rooftop, in the last month it swept the Celestial Granary, and then it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the jiwei day of the tenth month, a broom star appeared in the Root lodge, pointing toward the Tail, piercing Sheti, and heading toward the Great Horn; in the middle month it stood in Rooftop, in the last month it swept the Celestial Granary, and then it vanished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏主拓跋嗣薨，子燾立。

translations.literal: That year, the Wei ruler Tuoba Si died and his son Tao succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Wei ruler Tuoba Si died and his son Tao succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，[12]省寧州之江陽、犍為、安上三郡，合為宋昌郡。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, [12] the three commanderies of Jiangyang, Qianwei, and Anshang in Ningzhou were abolished and combined into Songchang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, [12] the three commanderies of Jiangyang, Qianwei, and Anshang in Ningzhou were abolished and combined into Songchang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, on the new moon of the second month, the day guisi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on the new moon of the second month, the day guisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: [13]廢南豫州刺史廬陵王義真為庶人，徙新安郡。

translations.literal: [13] The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, Inspector of South Yuzhou, was deposed as a commoner and moved to Xin'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [13] Prince of Luling Yizhen, Inspector of South Yuzhou, was deposed to commoner status and exiled to Xin'an Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以皇弟義恭為冠軍將軍，南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the emperor's younger brother Yigong was made General Who Establishes Champions and Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the emperor's younger brother Yigong was appointed General Who Establishes Champions and Inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大風，[14]天有五色雲，占者以為有兵。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, a great wind blew; [14] five-colored clouds appeared in the sky, and diviners took this as a sign of war.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, a great wind blew; [14] five-colored clouds appeared in the sky, and diviners interpreted this as a portent of war.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使貢獻。

translations.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 執政使使者誅義真于新安。

translations.literal: The regents sent an envoy to execute Yizhen at Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: The regents sent an envoy to execute Yizhen at Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，江州刺史王弘、南兗州刺史檀道濟入朝。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Wang Hong, Inspector of Jiangzhou, and Tan Daoji, Inspector of South Yanzhou, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, Wang Hong, Inspector of Jiangzhou, and Tan Daoji, Inspector of South Yanzhou, came to court.

sentences.zh: [15]帝居處所為多過失。

translations.literal: [15] In his conduct the emperor committed many faults.
translations.idiomatic: [15] In his conduct the emperor committed many faults.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，皇太后令曰：

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, the empress dowager issued an order, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the empress dowager issued an order, saying:

sentences.zh: 王室不造，天禍未悔，先帝創業弗永，棄世登遐。

translations.literal: The royal house has met with misfortune, Heaven's calamity has not yet relented, the late emperor's founding work did not last long, and he departed the world and ascended afar.
translations.idiomatic: The royal house has suffered misfortune; Heaven's wrath has not yet lifted; the late emperor's founding work was cut short when he died and passed beyond.

sentences.zh: 義符長嗣，屬當天位，不謂窮凶極悖，一至於此。

translations.literal: Yifu, as the eldest son and heir, was entrusted with the position under Heaven, yet who would have thought his utter villainy and extreme depravity would reach this point.
translations.idiomatic: Yifu, as the eldest son, was meant to inherit the throne under Heaven; none could have foreseen that his vicious depravity would go so far.

sentences.zh: 大行在殯，宇內哀惶，幸災肆於悖詞，喜容表於在慼。

translations.literal: While the late emperor lay in coffin, the realm mourned in grief, yet he took others' disaster as his pleasure and poured forth rebellious words, and showed joy upon his face even in the period of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: While the late emperor still lay in state and the realm mourned, he delighted in others' misfortune and spoke rebelliously, wearing a cheerful countenance even amid mourning.

sentences.zh: 至乃徵召樂府，鳩集伶官，優倡管絃，靡不備奏，珍羞甘膳，有加平日。

translations.literal: He even summoned the Music Bureau, gathered actors, and had singers, musicians, and string players all perform without exception; rare delicacies and fine foods exceeded those of ordinary days.
translations.idiomatic: He even summoned the Music Bureau, gathered performers, and had singers, musicians, and string players perform without exception; delicacies and fine foods exceeded those of ordinary days.

sentences.zh: 採擇媵御，產子就宮，靦然無怍，醜聲四達。

translations.literal: He selected concubines, and when they bore children he brought them into the palace with perfect composure and no shame; foul reports spread in every direction.
translations.idiomatic: He selected concubines, and when they bore children he brought them into the palace without the least shame; scandal spread in every direction.

sentences.zh: 及懿后崩背，重加天罰，親與左右執紼歌呼，推排梓宮，抃掌笑謔，殿省備聞。

translations.literal: When Empress Yi died, Heaven added a further punishment: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, clapped his hands and laughed and jested—the palace offices all heard of it.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Yi died, he added Heaven's punishment to his own: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, and clapped his hands in laughter and jest—the palace offices all heard of it.

sentences.zh: 加復日夜媟狎，羣小慢戲，興造千計，費用萬端，帑藏空虛，人力殫盡。

translations.literal: Moreover, day and night he indulged in lewd sport; his petty followers treated him with disrespect; he launched a thousand projects and spent ten thousand sums; the treasury was emptied and manpower exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, day and night he indulged in lewd sport; his petty followers treated him with disrespect; he launched a thousand projects and spent ten thousand sums; the treasury was emptied and manpower exhausted.

sentences.zh: 刑罰苛虐，幽囚日增。

translations.literal: Punishments were harsh and cruel, and those imprisoned increased daily.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments were harsh and cruel, and those imprisoned increased daily.

sentences.zh: 居帝王之位，好皁隸之役，處萬乘之尊，悅廝養之事。

translations.literal: Though he occupied the position of an emperor, he delighted in the tasks of black-clad servants; though he possessed the honor of the ten-thousand-chariot ruler, he took pleasure in groom and stable work.
translations.idiomatic: Though he occupied the throne, he delighted in the tasks of menial servants; though he possessed imperial dignity, he took pleasure in groom and stable work.

sentences.zh: 親執鞭撲，毆擊無辜，以為笑樂。

translations.literal: He personally wielded the whip and flail, beat the innocent, and made this his amusement.
translations.idiomatic: He personally wielded the whip and flail, beat the innocent, and made this his amusement.

sentences.zh: 穿池築觀，朝成暮毀，徵發工匠，疲極兆民。

translations.literal: He dug ponds and built towers, completing them in the morning and destroying them in the evening; he conscripted craftsmen until the people were exhausted to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: He dug ponds and built towers, completing them in the morning and destroying them in the evening; he conscripted craftsmen until the people were exhausted to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 遠近歎嗟，人神怨怒，社稷將墜，豈可復嗣守洪業，君臨萬邦。

translations.literal: Near and far sighed in lament; men and spirits were angered; the altars of soil and grain were about to fall—how could he again inherit and guard the great enterprise and rule the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far sighed in lament; men and spirits were angered; the altars of soil and grain were about to fall—how could he again inherit and guard the great enterprise and rule the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 今廢為營陽王，一依漢昌邑、晉海西故事。

translations.literal: He is now deposed as Prince of Yingyang, following entirely the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Emperor Haixi.
translations.idiomatic: He is now deposed as Prince of Yingyang, following entirely the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Emperor Haixi.

sentences.zh: 鎮〔西將軍宜都王，仁明孝弟，著自幼辰。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the West, the Prince of Yidu, is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal, renowned from his earliest years.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yidu, General Who Guards the West, is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal, renowned from his earliest years.

sentences.zh: 德業沖粹，識心明允。

translations.literal: His virtue and conduct are pure, and his mind and judgment are clear and fair.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue and conduct are pure, and his mind and judgment are clear and fair.

sentences.zh: 宜纂洪統，光臨億兆。

translations.literal: He should inherit the great succession and preside over the hundred million.
translations.idiomatic: He should inherit the great succession and preside over the hundred million.

sentences.zh: 主者詳依典故，以時奉迎。

translations.literal: The responsible officials should examine the precedents in detail and welcome him at the proper time.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials should examine the precedents in detail and welcome him at the proper time.

sentences.zh: 未亡人嬰此百罹，雖存若隕。

translations.literal: This surviving widow bears a hundred calamities; though alive, it is as if she had perished.
translations.idiomatic: This surviving widow bears a hundred calamities; though alive, it is as if she had perished.

sentences.zh: 永悼情事，撫心摧塞。

translations.literal: Forever grieving over these affairs, she presses her heart and is overwhelmed with anguish.
translations.idiomatic: Forever grieving over these affairs, she presses her heart and is overwhelmed with anguish.

translations.literal: 〕[16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: 〕[16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 始徐羨之、傅亮將廢帝，諷王弘、檀道濟求赴國訃。

translations.literal: At first Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang were about to depose the emperor; they hinted to Wang Hong and Tan Daoji that they should come for the state mourning.
translations.idiomatic: At first Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang were about to depose the emperor; they hinted to Wang Hong and Tan Daoji that they should come for the state mourning.

sentences.zh: 弘等來朝。

translations.literal: Hong and the others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Hong and the others came to court.

sentences.zh: 使中書舍人邢安泰、潘盛為內應。

translations.literal: They made the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai and Pan Sheng their inside contacts.
translations.idiomatic: They made the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai and Pan Sheng their inside contacts.

sentences.zh: 是旦，道濟、謝晦領兵居前，羨之等隨後，因東掖門開，入自雲龍門。

translations.literal: That morning, Tan Daoji and Xie Hui led troops in front while Xu Xianzhi and the others followed; because the East Side Gate was open, they entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That morning, Tan Daoji and Xie Hui led troops in front while Xu Xianzhi and the others followed; because the East Side Gate was open, they entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate.

sentences.zh: 盛等先戒宿衞，莫有禦者。

translations.literal: Sheng and the others had first warned the night guards, and none resisted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng and the others had first warned the night guards, and none resisted.

sentences.zh: 時帝於華林園為列肆，親自酤賣。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor was in the Hualin Garden setting up a row of shops and personally selling wine.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor was in the Hualin Garden setting up a row of shops and personally selling wine.

sentences.zh: 又開瀆聚土，以象破岡埭，與左右引船唱呼，以為歡樂。

translations.literal: He also opened a canal and piled earth to imitate the Pogang dam, and with his attendants pulled boats while shouting and calling—taking this as his pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened a canal and piled earth to imitate the Pogang dam, and with his attendants pulled boats while shouting and calling—taking this as his pleasure.

sentences.zh: 夕游天淵池，即龍舟而寢。

translations.literal: In the evening he toured the Tianyuan Pool and slept on the dragon boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the evening he toured the Tianyuan Pool and slept on the dragon boat.

sentences.zh: 其朝未興，兵士進，殺二侍者於帝側，傷帝指。

translations.literal: The court had not yet risen when soldiers entered, killed two attendants at the emperor's side, and wounded his finger.
translations.idiomatic: The court had not yet risen when soldiers entered, killed two attendants at the emperor's side, and wounded his finger.

sentences.zh: 夫出東閤，就收璽紱，羣臣拜辭，送於東宮，遂幽於吳郡。

translations.literal: He was taken out through the East Gate Pavilion, the seals and cords were taken from him, the officials bowed in farewell, he was sent to the Eastern Palace, and then confined in Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was taken out through the East Gate Pavilion, the seals and cords were taken from him, the officials bowed in farewell, he was sent to the Eastern Palace, and then confined in Wu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 是日，赦死罪以下。

translations.literal: That day, those sentenced to death and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: That day, those sentenced to death and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 太后令奉還璽紱。

translations.literal: The empress dowager ordered that the seals and cords be returned.

translations.literal: How hard it is! All editions omit this one line; only the Song edition underlying the Hanfenlou photolithographic Baona edition of the Hundred-Scroll edition has this surviving leaf.

sentences.zh: 蓋即本卷史臣曰之殘存結尾語。

translations.literal: Presumably it is the surviving closing line of the historian's judgment for this scroll.
